procedure: Local input-map rank, Jacobian row-space alignment and constrained tangent predictions answer local model questions, not whole-horizon physical acceptance.

C1 local mechanics was screening; four successful tendons are the smallest tested successful count, not a global lower bound. PHS-2D geometric matching could fail through finite deformation and slackening.

Bind model, operating point, physical input realization, task, grid and candidate before comparing predictions with observations. Reoptimized controls and changed structure are distinct interventions.
Use stable paired ablations or matched-input comparisons as discriminating evidence. P3 invalid fine-grid responses cannot establish a static mechanism by averaging their unstable tail.
